# cloud_sdk/tenant_config.rb
# Multi-tenant configuration manager for cloud infrastructure SDK
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'set'

module CloudSDK
  class TenantConfig
    RESERVED_KEYS = %w[__id__ __send__ class object_id].freeze
    IMMUTABLE_DEFAULTS = {
      'max_instances' => 100,
      'region' => 'us-east-1',
      'encryption' => 'aes-256-gcm',
      'isolation_level' => 'strict'
    }.freeze

    def initialize
      @tenants = {}
      @base_config = IMMUTABLE_DEFAULTS.dup
      @config_chain = {}
    end

    def register_tenant(tenant_id, opts = {})
      validate_tenant_id!(tenant_id)
      if @tenants.key?(tenant_id)
        raise ArgumentError, "Tenant already registered: #{tenant_id}"
      end
      @tenants[tenant_id] = {
        id: tenant_id,
        token: SecureRandom.hex(32),
        created_at: Time.now.utc,
        config: @base_config.dup
      }
      apply_tenant_options(tenant_id, opts) unless opts.empty?
      @tenants[tenant_id][:token]
    end

    def get_config(tenant_id, key)
      validate_tenant_id!(tenant_id)
      ensure_tenant_exists!(tenant_id)
      resolve_config_value(tenant_id, key)
    end

    def update_config(tenant_id, updates)
      validate_tenant_id!(tenant_id)
      ensure_tenant_exists!(tenant_id)
      validate_updates!(updates)
      merge_config(tenant_id, updates)
    end

    def set_config_inheritance(child_tenant, parent_tenant)
      validate_tenant_id!(child_tenant)
      validate_tenant_id!(parent_tenant)
      ensure_tenant_exists!(child_tenant)
      ensure_tenant_exists!(parent_tenant)
      detect_cycle!(child_tenant, parent_tenant)
      @config_chain[child_tenant] = parent_tenant
    end

    private

    def validate_tenant_id!(tenant_id)
      unless tenant_id.is_a?(String) && tenant_id.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}\z/)
        raise ArgumentError, "Invalid tenant ID format"
      end
    end

    def ensure_tenant_exists!(tenant_id)
      raise KeyError, "Tenant not found: #{tenant_id}" unless @tenants.key?(tenant_id)
    end

    def validate_updates!(updates)
      raise ArgumentError, "Updates must be a Hash" unless updates.is_a?(Hash)
      updates.each_key do |key|
        if RESERVED_KEYS.include?(key.to_s)
          raise ArgumentError, "Reserved key: #{key}"
        end
      end
    end

    def apply_tenant_options(tenant_id, opts)
      opts.each do |key, value|
        next if RESERVED_KEYS.include?(key.to_s)
        @tenants[tenant_id][:config][key.to_s] = value
      end
    end

    def merge_config(tenant_id, updates)
      updates.each do |key, value|
        if value.is_a?(Hash) && @tenants[tenant_id][:config][key.to_s].is_a?(Hash)
          deep_merge_into(@tenants[tenant_id][:config], key.to_s, value)
        else
          @tenants[tenant_id][:config][key.to_s] = value
        end
      end
    end

    def deep_merge_into(parent_hash, target_key, source)
      target = parent_hash[target_key]
      merged = {}
      target.each { |k, v| merged[k] = v }
      source.each do |key, value|
        str_key = key.to_s
        if value.is_a?(Hash) && merged[str_key].is_a?(Hash)
          merged[str_key] = isolated_merge(merged[str_key], value)
        else
          merged[str_key] = deep_copy(value)
        end
      end
      parent_hash[target_key] = merged.freeze
    end

    def isolated_merge(existing, incoming)
      result = {}
      existing.each { |k, v| result[k] = deep_copy(v) }
      incoming.each do |key, value|
        str_key = key.to_s
        if value.is_a?(Hash) && result[str_key].is_a?(Hash)
          result[str_key] = isolated_merge(result[str_key], value)
        else
          result[str_key] = deep_copy(value)
        end
      end
      result.freeze
    end

    def deep_copy(value)
      case value
      when Hash then value.each_with_object({}) { |(k, v), h| h[k.to_s] = deep_copy(v) }.freeze
      when Array then value.map { |v| deep_copy(v) }.freeze
      when String then value.dup.freeze
      else value
      end
    end

    def resolve_config_value(tenant_id, key)
      config = build_resolved_config(tenant_id)
      navigate_key_path(config, key)
    end

    def build_resolved_config(tenant_id, visited = Set.new)
      return {} if visited.include?(tenant_id)
      visited.add(tenant_id)

      parent_config = if @config_chain.key?(tenant_id)
        build_resolved_config(@config_chain[tenant_id], visited)
      else
        deep_copy(@base_config)
      end

      result = {}
      parent_config.each { |k, v| result[k] = deep_copy(v) }
      tenant_cfg = @tenants[tenant_id][:config]
      tenant_cfg.each do |k, v|
        if v.is_a?(Hash) && result[k].is_a?(Hash)
          result[k] = isolated_merge(result[k], v)
        else
          result[k] = deep_copy(v)
        end
      end
      result.freeze
    end

    def navigate_key_path(config, key_path)
      keys = key_path.to_s.split('.')
      current = config
      keys.each do |k|
        return nil unless current.is_a?(Hash)
        current = current[k]
      end
      current
    end

    def detect_cycle!(child, parent)
      current = parent
      visited = Set.new([child])
      while @config_chain.key?(current)
        if visited.include?(current)
          raise ArgumentError, "Circular inheritance detected"
        end
        visited.add(current)
        current = @config_chain[current]
      end
    end
  end

  class ConfigSerializer
    def self.from_user_input(json_string)
      parsed = JSON.parse(json_string)
      raise ArgumentError, "Expected object" unless parsed.is_a?(Hash)
      sanitize_config(parsed)
    end

    def self.sanitize_config(hash)
      result = {}
      hash.each do |key, value|
        str_key = key.to_s
        next if str_key.start_with?('_')
        next if str_key.include?('__proto__')
        if value.is_a?(Hash)
          result[str_key] = sanitize_config(value)
        elsif value.is_a?(Array)
          result[str_key] = value.map { |v| v.is_a?(Hash) ? sanitize_config(v) : v }
        else
          result[str_key] = value
        end
      end
      result
    end
  end
end
